data-analysis.title: Data Analysis
data-analysis.shortDescription: Deep-dive diagnostics to uncover hidden operational efficiencies and market trends.
data-analysis.summary: Practical data auditing, parsing, and exploratory analysis that surfaces the patterns your business has been missing.
data-analysis.overview: Our Data Analysis service goes beyond surface-level reporting. We dig deep into your raw data to uncover hidden patterns, anomalies, and opportunities that your team might be missing. Whether you have structured databases, spreadsheets, or disparate data sources, we turn them into a coherent story backed by statistical rigor.
data-analysis.forWho: Teams sitting on data they don't trust — or don't yet know how to use.
data-analysis.problem: Most SMBs have data spread across CRMs, ERPs, spreadsheets, and cloud tools — but no way to see the full picture.
deliverables: Cleaned, documented dataset ready for BI
Recommended next steps and quick wins

testimonial.quote: In three weeks we knew more about our customers than we'd learned in three years.

faq.question: Do you need access to production data?
faq.answer: We typically work with anonymized samples or staging environments first.

faq.question: What tools do you use?
faq.answer: Python, SQL, and dbt for analysis; Looker / Metabase / Power BI for reporting.

business-intelligence.title: Business Intelligence
business-intelligence.shortDescription: Custom real-time dashboards that put key metrics in the hands of decision makers.
business-intelligence.summary: We design and ship interactive BI dashboards that your team will actually use every day.
business-intelligence.overview: We design and build BI solutions that turn your data warehouse into a decision-making engine. From executive KPI dashboards to department-level operational reports, we create intuitive visualizations your team will actually use every day.
business-intelligence.forWho: Leaders tired of waiting on spreadsheets to make decisions.
business-intelligence.problem: Excel files and static PDFs don't scale. Your team needs live, interactive dashboards that update automatically.
deliverables: Connected dashboards (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, or Tableau)
Modeled metrics layer with shared definitions

testimonial.quote: Our weekly board meeting went from a chore to a five-minute review.

faq.question: Which BI tool do you recommend?
faq.answer: We're tool-agnostic — we pick what fits your team and budget.

faq.question: Can you integrate with our warehouse?
faq.answer: Yes — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Postgres.

machine-learning.title: Machine Learning
machine-learning.shortDescription: Predictive modeling and custom AI integrations to automate complex reasoning.
machine-learning.summary: From churn prediction to demand forecasting, we ship ML models that move business metrics.
machine-learning.overview: We build custom ML models tailored to your specific business problems — from demand forecasting and churn prediction to anomaly detection and recommendation engines. No off-the-shelf black boxes; every model is explained, tested, and built with your team's understanding in mind.
machine-learning.forWho: Teams ready to graduate from descriptive to predictive analytics.
machine-learning.problem: Reactive decision-making based on historical reports leaves money on the table. Predictive models let you act before problems arise.
deliverables: API or batch integration with your stack

faq.question: How much data do we need?

data-auditing.title: Data Auditing
data-auditing.shortDescription: Quality assurance and compliance reviews for GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2.
data-auditing.summary: We assess the health of your data — completeness, accuracy, lineage, and compliance — and give you a remediation plan.
data-auditing.overview: Bad data costs businesses an average of $12.9M per year. Our Data Auditing service identifies exactly where your data quality issues are, how serious they are, and what to do about them — before they impact your operations or compliance.
data-auditing.forWho: Companies preparing for compliance, M&A, or a major data project.
data-auditing.problem: Duplicate records, missing fields, inconsistent formats, and stale data silently corrupt every report and decision built on top of them.

timeline.title: Inventory

timeline.title: Report
timeline.description: Deliver findings with a prioritized roadmap.

testimonial.quote: We sailed through SOC 2 thanks to the prep work ShineTechData did.

faq.question: Do you audit our cloud configuration too?
faq.answer: We focus on data, but partner with security firms for full infra audits.

faq.question: How long does an audit take?
faq.answer: Most audits complete in 2–4 weeks depending on scope.

digital-transformation.title: Digital Transformation
digital-transformation.shortDescription: Legacy system migration to cloud-native, scalable microservices architectures.
digital-transformation.summary: Modernize your tech stack without breaking what's working. We plan and execute pragmatic, phased transformations.
digital-transformation.overview: Digital transformation isn't about replacing everything at once. We take a phased, pragmatic approach to modernizing your technology stack — starting with the highest-impact changes and building toward a fully integrated, data-driven operation.
digital-transformation.forWho: SMBs ready to move beyond spreadsheets and legacy CRMs.
digital-transformation.problem: Outdated systems can't share data, create silos, slow teams down, and make accurate reporting nearly impossible.
deliverables: Cloud architecture and data warehouse setup
Integration layer between old and new systems

timeline.title: Assess
timeline.description: Audit current systems, costs, and risks.

testimonial.quote: We replaced eight tools with one platform and cut costs by 60%.

faq.question: How do you avoid disruption?
faq.answer: Parallel running, phased rollouts, and aggressive testing.

faq.question: Do you handle change management?
faq.answer: Yes — training, documentation, and adoption tracking are included.

process-automation.title: Process Automation
process-automation.shortDescription: Eliminating repetitive tasks with robust RPA and custom API workflows.
process-automation.summary: We identify the manual workflows draining your team and replace them with reliable automation.
process-automation.overview: We identify, design, and implement automation solutions that replace time-consuming manual processes across your business. From automated reporting and data sync to intelligent workflow triggers and approvals, we help your team work smarter.
process-automation.forWho: Operations and finance teams stuck in copy-paste hell.
process-automation.problem: Manual processes are slow, error-prone, and expensive. Every hour spent on repetitive tasks is an hour not spent on growth.
deliverables: Built and deployed automations (n8n, Zapier, Make, or custom)

testimonial.quote: Our finance team got 30 hours a week back. Game changer.

faq.question: Which automation platforms do you use?
faq.answer: Mostly n8n and Make for visual workflows, or custom code when needed.

faq.question: Who maintains the automations?
faq.answer: We hand off with docs; we can also offer ongoing support.
